name: Jemaah Public Registration — Open and Verify Form Fields

planSteps.description: The registration modal opens with heading 'Formulir Pendaftaran Jemaah'
Input fields for 'Nama Lengkap', 'Kategori Jemaah', and 'Alamat Lengkap' are present
Click the close button on the registration modal
The modal closes and the main landing page content is interactive
